description: This file defines the ArrowFunctionExpression class, representing an arrow function node in Twig's AST. It includes methods for constructing the node and compiling it into executable PHP code.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\ArrowFunctionExpression
classes.description: Represents an arrow function node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, providing mechanisms for construction and compilation into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ArrowFunctionExpression node with the given expression, parameter names, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code that defines the arrow function based on the node's expression and parameter names.
